ayahs.textArabic: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِيْ بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُۖ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Tabārakal-lażī biyadihil-mulk(u), wa huwa ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: HALLOWED be He in whose hand all dominion rests, since He has the power to will anything:

ayahs.textArabic: ۨالَّذِيْ خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيٰوةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ اَيُّكُمْ اَحْسَنُ عَمَلًاۗ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْغَفُوْرُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażī khalaqal-mauta wal-ḥayāta liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ‘amalā(n), wa huwal-‘azīzul-gafūr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: He who has created death as well as life, so that He might put you to a test [and thus show] which of you is best in conduct, and [make you realize that] He alone is almighty, truly forgiving.

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاۗ مَا تَرٰى فِيْ خَلْقِ الرَّحْمٰنِ مِنْ تَفٰوُتٍۗ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَۙ هَلْ تَرٰى مِنْ فُطُوْرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażī khalaqa sab‘a samāwātin ṭibāqā(n), mā tarā fī khalqir-raḥmāni min tafāwut(in), farji‘il-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Hallowed be] He who has created seven heavens in full harmony with one another: no fault will thou see in the creation of the Most Gracious. And turn thy vision [upon it] once more: canst thou see any flaw?

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنْقَلِبْ اِلَيْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَّهُوَ حَسِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡummarji‘il-baṣara karrataini yanqalib ilaikal-baṣaru khāsi'aw wa huwa ḥasīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yea, turn thy vision [upon it] again and yet again: [and every time] thy vision will fall back upon thee, dazzled and truly defeated….

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّمَاۤءَ الدُّنْيَا بِمَصَابِيْحَ وَجَعَلْنٰهَا رُجُوْمًا لِّلشَّيٰطِيْنِ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِيْرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad zayyannas-samā'ad-dun-yā bimaṣābīḥa wa ja‘alnāhā rujūmal lisy-syayāṭīni wa a‘tadnā lahum ‘ażābas-sa‘īr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, indeed, We have adorned the skies nearest to the earth with lights, and have made them the object of futile guesses for the evil ones [from among men]: and for them have We readied suffering through a blazing flame –

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۗ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيْرُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lil-lażīna kafarū birabbihim ‘ażābu jahannam(a), wa bi'sal-maṣīr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, suffering in hell awaits all who are [thus] bent on blaspheming against their Sustainer: and how vile a journey's end!

ayahs.textArabic: اِذَآ اُلْقُوْا فِيْهَا سَمِعُوْا لَهَا شَهِيْقًا وَّهِيَ تَفُوْرُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Iżā ulqū fīhā sami‘ū lahā syahīqaw wa hiya tafūr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: When they are cast into that [hell], they will hear its breath indrawing as it boils up,

ayahs.textArabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِۗ كُلَّمَآ اُلْقِيَ فِيْهَا فَوْجٌ سَاَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ اَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيْرٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Takādu tamayyazu minal-gaiẓ(i), kullamā ulqiya fīhā faujun sa'alahum khazanatuhā alam ya'tikum nażīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: well-nigh bursting with fury; [and] every time a host [of such sinners] is flung into it, its keepers will ask them, "Has no warner ever come to you?"

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا بَلٰى قَدْ جَاۤءَنَا نَذِيْرٌ ەۙ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍۖ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ كَبِيْرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū balā qad jā'anā nażīr(un), fa każżabnā wa qulnā mā nazzalallāhu min syai'(in), in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: They will reply: "Yea, a warner did indeed come unto us, but we gave him the lie and said, 'Never has God sent down anything [by way of revelation]! You [self-styled warners] are but lost in a great delusion!"'

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ اَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِيْٓ اَصْحٰبِ السَّعِيْرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū lau kunnā nasma‘u au na‘qilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābis-sa‘īr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they will add: "Had we but listened [to those warnings], or [at least] used our own reason, we would not [now] be among those who are destined for the blazing flame!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَاعْتَرَفُوْا بِذَنْۢبِهِمْۚ فَسُحْقًا لِّاَصْحٰبِ السَّعِيْرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa‘tarafū biżambihim, fasuḥqal li'aṣḥābis-sa‘īr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus will they come to realize their sins: but [by that time,] remote will have become all good from those who are destined for the blazing flame.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّاَجْرٌ كَبِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna yakhsyauna rabbahum bil-gaibi lahum magfiratuw wa ajrun kabīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [As against this,] behold, for those who stand in awe of God although He is beyond the reach of their perception, there is forgiveness in store and a great reward.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَسِرُّوْا قَوْلَكُمْ اَوِ اجْهَرُوْا بِهٖۗ اِنَّهٗ عَلِيْمٌ ۢبِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa asirrū qaulakum awijharū bih(ī), innahū ‘alīmum biżātiṣ-ṣudūr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [know, O men, that] whether you keep your beliefs secret or state them openly, He has full knowledge indeed of all that is in [your] hearts.

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَۗ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيْفُ الْخَبِيْرُ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Alā ya‘lamu man khalaq(a), wa huwal-laṭīful-khabīr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: How could it be that He who has created [all] should not know [all]? Yea, He alone is unfathomable [in His wisdom], aware!

ayahs.textArabic: هُوَ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ ذَلُوْلًا فَامْشُوْا فِيْ مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوْا مِنْ رِّزْقِهٖۗ وَاِلَيْهِ النُّشُوْرُ
ayahs.textLatin: Huwal-lażī ja‘ala lakumul-arḍa żalūlan famsyū fī manākibihā wa kulū mir rizqih(ī), wa ilaihin-nusyūr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: He it is who has made the earth easy to live upon: go about, then, in all its regions, and partake the sustenance which He provides: but [always bear in mind that] unto Him you shall be resurrected.

ayahs.textArabic: ءَاَمِنْتُمْ مَّنْ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ اَنْ يَّخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْاَرْضَ فَاِذَا هِيَ تَمُوْرُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: A'amintum man fis-samā'i ay yakhsifa bikumul-arḍa  fa'iżā hiya tamūr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Can you ever feel secure that He who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you up when, lo and behold, it begins to quake?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ اَمِنْتُمْ مَّنْ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ اَنْ يُّرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًاۗ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ كَيْفَ نَذِيْرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Am amintum man fis-samā'i ay yursila ‘alaikum ḥāṣibā(n), fa sata‘lamūna kaifa nażīr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or can you ever feel secure that He who is in heaven will not let loose against you a deadly stormwind, whereupon you would come to know how [true] My warning was?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيْرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad każżabal-lażīna min qablihim fakaifa kāna nakīr(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, indeed, [many of] those who lived aforetime did give the lie [to My warnings]: and how awesome was My rejection [of them]!

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صٰۤفّٰتٍ وَّيَقْبِضْنَۘ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا الرَّحْمٰنُۗ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍۢ بَصِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yarau ilaṭ-ṭairi fauqahum ṣāffātiw wa yaqbiḍn(a), mā yumsikuhunna illar-raḥmān(u), innahū bikulli syai'im baṣīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Have they, then, never beheld the birds above them, spreading their wings and drawing them in? None but the Most Gracious upholds them: for, verily, He keeps all things in His sight.

ayahs.textArabic: اَمَّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ هُوَ جُنْدٌ لَّكُمْ يَنْصُرُكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ الرَّحْمٰنِۗ اِنِ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ اِلَّا فِيْ غُرُوْرٍۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Am man hāżal-lażī huwa jundul lakum yanṣurukum min dūnir-raḥmān(i), inil-kāfirūna illā fī gurūr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] is there any, besides the Most Gracious, that could be a shield for you, and could succour you [against danger]? They who deny this truth are but lost in self- delusion!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمَّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ يَرْزُقُكُمْ اِنْ اَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهٗ ۚ بَلْ لَّجُّوْا فِيْ عُتُوٍّ وَّنُفُوْرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Am man hāżal-lażī yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah(ū), bal lajjū fī ‘utuwwiw wa nufūr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or is there any that could provide you with sustenance if He should withhold His provision [from you]? Nay, but they [who are bent on denying the truth] stubbornly persist in their disdain [of God's messages] and in their headlong flight [from Him]!

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَمَنْ يَّمْشِيْ مُكِبًّا عَلٰى وَجْهِهٖٓ اَهْدٰىٓ اَمَّنْ يَّمْشِيْ سَوِيًّا عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Afamay yamsyī mukibban ‘alā wajhihī ahdā ammay yamsyī sawiyyan ‘alā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: But then, is he that goes along with his face close to the ground better guided than he that walks upright on a straight way?

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْشَاَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْـِٕدَةَۗ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul huwal-lażī ansya'akum wa ja‘ala lakumus-sam‘a wal-abṣāra wal-af'idah(ta), qalīlam mā tasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY: "[God is] He who has brought you [all] into being, and has endowed you with hearing, and sight, and hearts: [yet] how seldom are you grateful!"

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِيْ ذَرَاَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَاِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul huwal-lażī żara'akum fil-arḍi wa ilaihi tuḥsyarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "It is He who has multiplied you on earth; and it is unto Him that you shall be gathered [on resurrection]."

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaqūlūna matā hāżal-wa‘du in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But they [only] ask, "When is this promise to be fulfilled? [Answer this, O you who believe in it,] if you are men of truth!"

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ ۖوَاِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul innamal-‘ilmu ‘indallāh(i), wa innamā ana nażīrum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say thou, [O Prophet:] "Knowledge thereof rests with God alone; and I am only a plain warner."

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيْۤـَٔتْ وُجُوْهُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَقِيْلَ هٰذَا الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَدَّعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā ra'auhu zulfatan sī'at wujūhul-lażīna kafarū wa qīla hāżal-lażī kuntum bihī tadda‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Yet in the end, when they shall see that [fulfilment] close at hand, the faces of those who were bent on denying the truth will be stricken with grief; and they will be told, "This it is that you were [so derisively] calling for!"

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ اَهْلَكَنِيَ اللّٰهُ وَمَنْ مَّعِيَ اَوْ رَحِمَنَاۙ فَمَنْ يُّجِيْرُ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul ara'aitum in ahlakaniyallāhu wa mam ma‘iya au raḥimanā, famay yujīrul-kāfirīna min ‘ażābin alīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY [O Prophet]: "What do you think? Whether God destroys me and those who follow me, or graces us with His mercy - is there anyone that could protect [you] deniers of the truth from grievous suffering [in the life to come]?"

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَاۚ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ هُوَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul huwar-raḥmānu āmannā bihī wa ‘alaihi tawakkalnā, fasata‘lamūna man huwa fī ḍalālim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "He is the Most Gracious: we have attained to faith in Him, and in Him have we placed our trust; and in time you will come to know which of us was lost in manifest error."

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ اَرَءَيْتُمْ اِنْ اَصْبَحَ مَاۤؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ يَّأْتِيْكُمْ بِمَاۤءٍ مَّعِيْنٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul ara'aitum in aṣbaḥa mā'ukum gauran famay ya'tīkum bimā'im ma‘īn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say [unto those who deny the truth]: "What do you think? If of a sudden all your water were to vanish underground, who [but God] could provide you with water from [new] unsullied springs?"
